---
description: "Review and summarize remediation learning data"
mode: agent
agent: document-accessibility-wizard
---

Read `.a11y-remediation-knowledge.json` in the workspace root and provide a summary:

1. Per-rule fix success rates -- which rules are reliably auto-fixed vs which need human intervention
2. Common failure patterns -- what causes fixes to fail or regress
3. Reusable fix patterns -- templates that can be applied across documents
4. User preferences -- any format-specific settings or overrides recorded

Suggest improvements: rules that could be promoted from manual to auto-fix, patterns that should be added, and any stale or contradictory entries that should be cleaned up.
